text:
alex: Hey team — quick pass on the compact onboarding wizard I demoed earlier. Pulled together a few UX/copy/a11y nits after testing with 3 new hires.

maya: awesome, thanks. high level: does this aim to replace the full checklist or be a lightweight first-run layer?

alex: lightweight; it's the 30s path for people who want to try a sample project quickly, then the full checklist is available in the sidebar.

sam: I tried it on laptop and phone. Biggest issues: the banner copy feels vague, and the progress stepper isn't keyboard friendly.

jin: can you paste the exact banner copy here?

alex: current banner: "Quickstart — pick a sample and run in seconds"

karina: suggestion: shorter, action-first. e.g. "Try a sample project" with a subline "Run the model in your workspace in <1 minute". Keeps metadata optional.

sam: +1 to action-first. also the CTA currently says "Get Started" which conflicts with other flows. I propose "Run sample" or "Open sample" so it's unambiguous.

maya: UX question: do we show estimated time on all samples? if we show "~1 min" on every card it loses signal. maybe only for the tiny demo samples.

alex: agree. only annotate the 1-min quick demos. others show complexity labels ("requires Dedicated", "tokens: med").

jin: keyboard focus order: when you tab into the wizard modal it lands on the close X, then jumps to the first sample card (good) but the stepper dots are not reachable by keyboard; users can't skip forward/back which matters for screen-reader navigation.

karina: can we merge stepper controls into visible previous/next buttons with aria-labels instead of bare dots? e.g. left chevron (aria-label="Previous step") and right chevron (aria-label="Next step") so screenreaders have context.

alex: yes — internal note: replace dots with buttons + hide decorative dots from SR with aria-hidden.

sam: color contrast: the sample card meta (tiny grey text) drops under 3:1 on low brightness devices. Need to bump to meet 4.5:1 for body text.

maya: copy nit — sample card subtitle currently uses sentence case but we use title case in other surfaces. Which is our system?

karina: product system uses sentence case for descriptive copy and Title Case for headlines. So subtitle -> sentence case. Headline stay Title Case.

alex: on CTA hierarchy, the primary CTA in the wizard sometimes sits next to a secondary link "View checklist". On mobile they collapse weirdly. Proposed layout: primary action full-width, secondary as text link under it (mobile). Desktop: primary + outline secondary inline.

jin: accessibility: add focus-visible outlines for both primary and secondary — currently only primary shows outline. Users navigating by keyboard on mac with custom themes lost focus.

sam: telemetry ask: can deploy-bot add an event for "onboard_wizard_started" and "onboard_sample_launched" with sample_id? we want to measure completion vs drop-off.

deploy-bot: noted. I can add provisional events to the analytics pipeline. Will need sample_id mapping and whether user was new (created <24h).

maya: copy alternatives to A/B test (short list):
```
Variant A headline: "Try a sample project"
Subline: "Run a working example in your workspace in under 1 minute"
Primary CTA: "Run sample"
Secondary: "View setup checklist"
```
```
Variant B headline: "Get started with a sample"
Subline: "Explore curated examples — no setup required"
Primary CTA: "Open sample"
Secondary: "See full checklist"
```

karina: prefer A for clarity. B leans safer but less decisive.

alex: UX microcopy for empty-state after a failed run (very important): current text is "Run failed. Try again." too terse. Suggest:
```
"Run failed — something went wrong while executing the sample.
Try again, or open the full checklist to run locally. If this keeps happening, copy the error and contact support."
```
Add a small "Copy error" button and an inline link to docs.

sam: +copy-button. Make sure the copy-button has aria-live region for SRs when copying succeeded.

jin: tiny visual: the badge for "1-min demo" uses rounded pill with 2px border that flickers on dark mode. Remove border in dark mode and increase padding to 6px 8px.

maya: can we get a quick feasibility check from eng-runtime? Are we okay adding telemetry + aria-live with next patch?

alex: tagging eng-runtime for review. Also want a small usability test with 5 external newbies to validate the updated copy and keyboard nav. Can design ops help schedule?

karina: I'll coordinate the 5-person unmoderated test and draft the test script.

alex: action items summary:
- karina: update microcopy variants and write the empty-state copy + aria-live spec (due EOD Wed)
- jin: replace stepper dots with accessible prev/next buttons + focus-visible fixes (PR by Thu)
- sam: bump color tokens for sample meta and mobile CTA layout fixes (PR by Thu)
- deploy-bot: analytics events for wizard start + sample launched (PR by Fri)
- maya: schedule 5-person usability run (by next Tue)

maya: thank you. quick follow: can we add screenshot of the modal in here for reference? I pasted a link in the design drive earlier — https://drive.company/internal/designs/onboard-compact-v3.png

alex: added, thanks. folks, if we agree I'll move copy into the component props and queue a small A/B for 2 weeks. :thumbsup:

karina: :thumbsup:

sam: merging notes into GH issue now — will reference this thread.

jin: will do keyboard test on VoiceOver and NVDA after PR.

alex: end."
